map.将 TOML 片段解析为 JSON 对象，支持嵌套表、数组与标准类型。适合把配置: Parses a TOML snippet into a JSON object, supporting nested tables, arrays and standard types. Suitable for feeding configuration files into JavaScript or APIs. Parsing happens locally.
map.表顺序在 JSON 中会被打乱(对象无序): Table order is not preserved in JSON, since objects are unordered
map.点号键如 a.b 会成嵌套: Dotted keys such as a.b become nested
map.能，按 ISO 字符串输出。: Yes, they are output as ISO strings.
map.→ 去使用 TOML 转 JSON（免费 · 纯前端 · 数据不上传）: Open TOML to JSON (free, pure front-end, nothing uploaded)
